name: PandaDoc
summary: Proposals, quotes and contracts with electronic signatures.

flows.title: Create a document
steps: Upload a file, or start from a template or a blank document.
Follow the guided creation flow: add recipients, then configure delivery and settings.
Select Send document in the top-right corner, or the link icon next to it to get a shareable link instead.

flows.title: Send a document for signature
steps: In the document, select Review and send in the top right corner.
Choose a delivery method for each recipient. For email, edit the subject line and add a message if needed.
Review the settings, such as expiration and auto-reminders, if relevant.

flows.title: See a sent document's audit trail
steps: Click Audit trail in the top right, or click File, then Document, then Audit trail, to see the list of activities for the document.
